ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi Storage Information Discovery Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "storage" flag in order to retrieve information about the storage status and other related information. Seen used by malware such as DarkSide and LockBit.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*storage.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ get.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ list.*")))
